variants.python.py:
"""python.py — Python variant of the Card type.

One of N language variants of the same type. The normative form is
schema.json in this directory. Lean, Rust, TypeScript variants will
live alongside this file once they're written.

L9: this variant exists. Other-language variants are tracked as
`lacking:` cards until they exist too.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Callable, Optional

STATUS_VALUES = ("healthy", "suspect", "broken", "quarantined")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Card:
    name:           str
    category:       str
    tier:           int = 0
    cost:           float = 0.0
    statement:      str = ""
    rationale:      str = ""
    problem:        str = ""
    solution:       str = ""
    location:       str = ""
    file_refs:      tuple[str, ...] = ()
    depends_on:     tuple[str, ...] = ()
    supersedes:     tuple[str, ...] = ()
    interacts_with: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    tags:           tuple[str, ...] = ()
    status:         str = "healthy"
    flaws:          tuple[str, ...] = ()
    witness:        Optional[Callable[[], bool]] = None
    variants:       dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    metadata:       dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def __post_init__(self):
        if self.status not in STATUS_VALUES:
            raise ValueError(f"status must be one of {STATUS_VALUES}, got {self.status!r}")
variants.schema.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://pheros.studio/schemas/card.schema.json",
  "title": "Card",
  "description": "The universal Card record. Every card in Pheros_Studio conforms to this.",
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["name", "category"],
  "properties": {
    "name":           { "type": "string", "pattern": "^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$" },
    "category":       { "type": "string", "pattern": "^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$" },
    "tier":           { "type": "integer", "minimum": 0 },
    "cost":           { "type": ["number", "object", "null"] },
    "statement":      { "type": "string" },
    "rationale":      { "type": "string" },
    "problem":        { "type": "string" },
    "solution":       { "type": "string" },
    "location":       { "type": "string" },
    "file_refs":      { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } },
    "depends_on":     { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } },
    "supersedes":     { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } },
    "interacts_with": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } },
    "tags":           { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } },
    "status":         { "type": "string", "enum": ["healthy", "suspect", "broken", "quarantined"] },
    "flaws":          { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } },
    "witness":        { "type": ["string", "null"], "description": "qualified name of the witness predicate, or null" },
    "variants":       { "type": "object", "description": "map of filename -> file content for language/format variants" },
    "metadata":       { "type": "object", "description": "open extension point — registries MAY add fields; consumers MUST ignore unknown ones" }
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
